title: Noon Sakinah & Tanween Rules
body: When noon ساكنة (or tanween) meets the next letter, one of FOUR things happens:
rules: with ء ه ع ح غ خ — pronounce noon plainly, no nasalization.
with ي ر م ل و ن — noon melts into the letter. With ي ن م و add ghunnah (nasal).
with ب — noon becomes a hidden meem + ghunnah.
with the remaining 15 letters — noon hides, ghunnah ~2 counts.

title: Meem Sakinah Rules
rules: followed by ب — hide meem w/ light ghunnah.
followed by م — merge into meem w/ ghunnah.

title: Madd (Elongation) Rules
body: Any madd letter (ا و ي) stretches its vowel:
rules: 4-5 counts — madd + hamza in SAME word.
4-5 counts — madd ends word, hamza starts next.

title: Qalqalah, Tafkheem & Waqf
rules: echo letters ق ط ب ج د — bounce them when sakinah.
خ ص ض ط ظ غ ق + heavy ر — full mouth.
م stop required · لا don't stop · جلى permissible · صلى preferred.
